seo.title: Udo Island Day Trip in Jeju (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover the best udo island day trip in Jeju for 2026 — curated picks with maps, hours, and insider tips.

hero.h1: N Best Ferry to Jeju's tiny Udo Island for peanut soft-serve ice cream, glass-clear snorkeling, and a moped loop past lighthouse cliffs and wildflower meadows.
hero.subtitle: Essential picks for Udo Island's unique flavors, sights, and adventures, just a short ferry ride from Jeju.

picks.name: Blanc Rocher (블랑로쉐)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Perched with breathtaking views of Sanho Beach and the turquoise sea, Blanc Rocher is iconic for its Udo peanut ice cream. This stylish cafe offers a relaxing atmosphere where you can savor delicious desserts and artisanal coffee while soaking in the island's natural beauty.
picks.whatToOrder: Udo Peanut Ice Cream and a Hand-Drip Coffee
picks.insiderTip: Go early in the morning to snag a window seat and enjoy the tranquil views before the midday crowds arrive.
picks.redditQuote: "Blanc Rocher is an absolute must-visit on Udo, their peanut ice cream is legendary and the views are just insane. Worth the ferry ride alone!"

picks.name: Udo King Lobster & Seafood (우도왕소라횟집)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Located conveniently near Cheonjin Port, this restaurant is renowned for its incredibly fresh seafood, often caught by local haenyeo (female divers). Their signature dishes include abalone hotpot and grilled lobster, served in a vibrant, bustling environment perfect for a post-ferry feast.
picks.insiderTip: It can get very busy, especially during lunch hours. Try to visit slightly off-peak or be prepared for a short wait.
picks.redditQuote: "We hit up Udo King Lobster right after getting off the ferry, and that abalone hotpot was a game changer. So fresh, so good after a long morning!"

picks.name: Udo Bike & Car Rental (우도바이크)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The best way to explore Udo Island is by moped or electric car, and Udo Bike & Car Rental offers a wide selection of well-maintained vehicles. With friendly staff and clear instructions, they make it easy to embark on your scenic island loop, passing by lighthouse cliffs and serene wildflower fields.
picks.whatToOrder: Electric Bicycle or Small Electric Car Rental
picks.insiderTip: Bring your international driving permit if you plan to rent a gasoline-powered scooter or a car. Electric vehicles often require less stringent licenses.
picks.redditQuote: "Renting an electric car from Udo Bike & Car Rental was the smartest move. Super easy to navigate the island, and we saw everything without breaking a sweat."

picks.name: Udo Peanut Prince (우도 땅콩왕자)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Udo Peanut Prince is a delightful spot dedicated to all things peanut, from their famed peanut soft-serve to crunchy peanut snacks and even peanut makgeolli. It's a fun and casual stop to indulge in the island's signature crop, perfect for a quick, sweet treat.
picks.whatToOrder: Original Udo Peanut Soft-Serve Ice Cream
picks.insiderTip: They often have unique seasonal peanut products; ask for any limited-edition treats during your visit.
picks.redditQuote: "Udo Peanut Prince had the best peanut ice cream on the island, hands down. So nutty and creamy, totally hit the spot after walking around."

picks.name: Cafe Sanho (카페산호)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Boasting direct views of the stunning Sanho Beach (Coral Beach), Cafe Sanho is an idyllic spot to relax and enjoy a coffee or a light snack. Its comfortable ambiance and picturesque setting make it perfect for unwinding after some snorkeling or beachcombing.
picks.whatToOrder: Iced Americano with a slice of local tangerine cake
picks.insiderTip: Grab a seat on their outdoor terrace for the best panoramic views of the coral-white sand and emerald waters.
picks.redditQuote: "Cafe Sanho right by the beach was my favorite place to chill. That view of the water with a cold coffee? Pure bliss."

picks.name: Udo Jjajang (우도짜장)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A popular eatery known for its unique take on Korean-Chinese dishes, Udo Jjajang specializes in seafood jjajangmyeon and jjampong. Their noodles are famously topped with fresh Udo seafood like abalone, conch, and mussels, offering a robust flavor profile unique to the island.
picks.insiderTip: They can sometimes run out of popular seafood toppings later in the day, so it's best to visit for an early lunch.
picks.redditQuote: "You HAVE to try the seafood jjajangmyeon at Udo Jjajang. The abalone in it was so tender and the sauce was incredible."

picks.name: MungBean Story (땅콩콩 이야기)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: MungBean Story is a charming cafe that crafts creative dishes and desserts primarily using Udo's famous peanuts. From creamy peanut smoothies to crispy peanut waffles, it’s a cozy spot to enjoy innovative takes on local flavors, often with rustic, charming decor.
picks.whatToOrder: Udo Peanut Smoothie and Peanut Waffles
picks.insiderTip: They sell packaged peanut products perfect for souvenirs, like roasted Udo peanuts and peanut-infused chocolates.
picks.redditQuote: "Loved MungBean Story! Their peanut smoothie was surprisingly delicious and a great cool-down after hiking Udobong."

picks.name: Udo Black Pork Haenyeo's House (우도흑돼지해녀의집)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Experience the famous Jeju black pork with an Udo twist at this lively restaurant. The charcoal-grilled black pork is known for its rich flavor and tender texture, served with an array of traditional Korean side dishes, making for an authentic and satisfying meal.
picks.insiderTip: Pair your black pork with a bottle of Jeju's local hallasan soju for an authentic dining experience.
picks.redditQuote: "The black pork at Udo Black Pork Haenyeo's House was seriously good. Juicy, fatty, perfectly cooked. Best meal on Udo!"

picks.name: Udo Kimsnack (우도 김스낵)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A no-frills, highly-rated spot for quick, delicious Korean snacks. Udo Kimsnack is perfect for a budget-friendly meal or a convenient bite on the go. They serve classic Korean comfort foods like tteokbokki, gimbap, and eomuk, prepared fresh to order.
picks.whatToOrder: Spicy Tteokbokki and a Gimbap roll
picks.insiderTip: This is a great place to grab a packed lunch before heading out for a full day of exploring or snorkeling.
picks.redditQuote: "Udo Kimsnack saved my wallet and my stomach! Their tteokbokki was surprisingly good for such a small place, perfect quick bite."

picks.name: Cafe Punggyeong (카페 풍경)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Situated near the stunning Hagosudong Beach, Cafe Punggyeong offers a tranquil escape with beautiful ocean views. Enjoy a refreshing beverage or a light snack as you gaze out at the clear waters and the distant Jeju coastline, a perfect spot for unwinding.
picks.whatToOrder: Iced Grapefruit Ade and a fresh fruit tart
picks.insiderTip: They have comfortable indoor seating with large windows, making it a great refuge on a hot day or if it's a bit windy by the beach.
picks.redditQuote: "We stopped at Cafe Punggyeong by Hagosudong, and the name (Punggyeong means 'scenery') really lives up to it. The view was incredible!"

picks.name: Udo Mermaids (우도 머메이드)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nestled near the unique black sands of Geommeolle Beach, Udo Mermaids is a quirky and charming cafe known for its mermaid-themed decor and colorful, Instagrammable drinks and desserts. It’s a fun, whimsical spot perfect for snapping photos and enjoying creative treats.
picks.whatToOrder: Mermaid Tail Smoothie or their signature 'Udo Blue' latte
picks.insiderTip: After visiting, take a walk down to Geommeolle Beach to see the fascinating sea caves accessible at low tide.
picks.redditQuote: "Udo Mermaids was super cute! The mermaid tail smoothie was adorable, and the vibe was just really fun and quirky after exploring the dark sand beach."

picks.name: Dalgorae Bingsu Cafe (달고래빙수카페)
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Specializing in Korean shaved ice desserts (bingsu), Dalgorae Bingsu Cafe offers a refreshing break, especially on a warm Udo day. Their bingsu creations feature fresh fruits, local ingredients like peanuts and tangerines, and generous toppings, perfect for sharing.
picks.whatToOrder: Udo Peanut Bingsu or Jeju Tangerine Bingsu
picks.insiderTip: Bingsu portions are quite large, so it's ideal for sharing between two or three people.
picks.redditQuote: "We demolished the Udo Peanut Bingsu at Dalgorae Bingsu Cafe – definitely worth the calories. So much better than just regular ice cream!"

faq.question: How do I get to Udo Island from Jeju?
faq.answer: You can get to Udo Island by taking a ferry from either Seongsan Port or Jongdal Port on Jeju Island. Ferries run frequently throughout the day, typically every 30 minutes to an hour, and the journey takes about 15-20 minutes. Remember to bring your ID (passport for foreigners) to purchase tickets.

faq.question: What is the best way to get around Udo Island?
faq.answer: The most popular and recommended way to explore Udo Island is by renting an electric scooter, bicycle, or a small electric car. Private cars are generally not allowed for tourists on the island, though there is a local bus service that circles the island's main attractions. Rentals are available right at the ferry ports.

faq.question: What are Udo Island's famous local specialties?
faq.answer: Udo Island is most famous for its peanuts, which are used in various forms like peanut soft-serve ice cream, peanut snacks, and even peanut makgeolli. Fresh seafood, especially abalone and conch, is also a must-try. Additionally, you'll find various Jeju tangerine-based products due to its proximity to Jeju Island.

faq.question: Can I snorkel or swim on Udo Island?
faq.answer: Yes, Udo Island boasts several beautiful beaches perfect for snorkeling and swimming. Sanho Beach (Coral Beach) and Hagosudong Beach are particularly known for their clear, turquoise waters and white sandy shores. You can often find equipment rentals at or near these beaches during peak season.

faq.question: How long should I plan for a trip to Udo Island?
faq.answer: Most visitors spend a half-day to a full day exploring Udo Island. A full loop around the island by moped or electric car, with stops at major attractions, cafes, and beaches, typically takes about 4-6 hours. If you plan to hike Udobong Peak or spend extended time at the beaches, a full day is recommended.

faq.question: Are there accommodations available on Udo Island?
faq.answer: Yes, Udo Island offers a range of accommodations, including guesthouses, pensions, and a few small hotels. Staying overnight allows for a more relaxed experience, enabling you to enjoy the island's serene evenings and early mornings before the main crowds arrive. Booking in advance is recommended, especially during peak travel seasons.

We considered reviews from local guides, travel blogs, and visitor feedback to highlight authentic experiences and high-quality services, ensuring a memorable visit to this beautiful island.
